title: Vanilla RNN Forward
signature: def rnn_forward(x, h0, W_xh, W_hh, b) -> np.ndarray
hints: The time steps depend on each other, so loop over t. Each step is still a batched matrix product.
With row-vector inputs the update is h = tanh(x_t @ W_xh + h @ W_hh + b). W_hh is not transposed.
Store h after each update. h0 itself is not part of the output, so the result has T states, not T + 1.
